description: Price a Guard — CurrencyGuard's FX protection product for real future payments or receipts. If a tenor like '3 months' is given, call resolve_settlement_date first to get the exact date, then call this tool. Returns: guardType (Guard-Pay or Guard-Receive), guardRate, guardFee (in the home currency), guardFeePct (a FRACTION: 0.0096 means 0.96%), guardFeePercent (the same figure written as a percentage, e.g. "0.96%" — quote this one), effectiveRate, guardAmount (the foreign amount converted at the Guard rate, in the home currency, WITHOUT the fee), foreignAmount, spotRate, settlementDate, settlementWindowFrom (the first day the Guard rate can be used; the window runs from there to settlementDate, counted in business days on the trading calendar, so over holidays it opens earlier than 14 calendar days), payLaterCreditFee (the extra charged if the fee is paid at settlement instead of up front), valid, errors, stale. Pilot limit: the Guard amount cannot exceed 1,000,000 in the home currency. Say so before quoting if the amount is clearly above it. The Guard fee is separate money. A payer funds guardAmount plus guardFee; a receiver nets guardAmount minus guardFee. effectiveRate is that all-in figure expressed as a rate. All quotes are indicative, because a Guard is bought through the customer's payment provider, who sets the final rate and fee. Say that reason when you say "indicative".

foreignAmount.description: Amount in foreign currency to protect

foreignCurrency.description: Foreign currency ISO code, e.g. USD

guardCurrency.description: Home/base currency ISO code, e.g. GBP

guardRate.description: Fixed Guard rate to price at instead of the current market rate. Leave empty to price at the current rate.

payReceive.description: PAY if paying foreign currency, RECEIVE if receiving it

settlementDate.description: Settlement date in ISO format YYYY-MM-DD
